text:
The capital of France is Paris.

Artistic Concept: "The Sublime Rebellion"

This concept envisions a large-scale installation that captures the essence of late 18th-century Romanticism as a visceral reaction against the cold logic of the Enlightenment and the encroaching machinery of the Industrial Revolution. The aesthetic is defined by dramatic chiaroscuro, where deep, moody shadows clash with sudden, ethereal bursts of light, evoking the mysterious and the sublime.

The central value of the piece is the celebration of raw human emotion and individualism. Instead of structured, geometric forms, the installation features organic, swirling structures made of weathered wood and mist, representing the untamed power of nature. Viewers are immersed in a soundscape of distant thunder and whispering winds, designed to evoke a profound emotional response rather than intellectual analysis. The fantastical elements are introduced through projected imagery of towering, ancient forests and stormy seas, reminding the audience of the awe-inspiring and terrifying beauty of the natural world, standing in stark contrast to the rigid rationality it sought to reject.
